(* INPUT CELL 1 *)
ClearAll[radicalDepth];
radicalDepth[x_/;FreeQ[x,_^_Rational|_Sin|_Cos]]=0;
radicalDepth[x_]:=radicalDepth[x]=1+Max[radicalDepth/@Union[Cases[x,(b_)^(_Rational) :> b,All],Cases[x,Sin[b_] :> b,All],Cases[x,Cos[b_] :> b,All]]];

(* INPUT CELL 2 *)
ClearAll[findExtension];
findExtension[root_]:=Block[{p,q,x},
With[{mp=If[root[[0]]===Root,MinimalPolynomial[root,x],root]},MinimalBy[
DeleteCases[p/.Solve[Exists[q,LogicalExpand[!Eliminate[PolynomialRemainder[mp,(x)^(2)+p x+q,x] != 0,x]]],p],_?ExactNumberQ],
Simplify`SimpifyCount,1]]][[1]];

(* INPUT CELL 3 *)
ClearAll[findExtension3];findExtension3[root_]:=Block[{p,q,r,x},With[{mp=If[root[[0]]===Root,MinimalPolynomial[root,x],root]},MinimalBy[DeleteCases[p/. Solve[\[Exists]_{q,r}LogicalExpand[!Eliminate[PolynomialRemainder[mp,(x)^(3)+p (x)^(2)+q x+r,x] != 0,x]],p],_?ExactNumberQ],Simplify`SimpifyCount,1]]][[1]]

(* INPUT CELL 4 *)
ClearAll[project];
project[r_Root]:=Block[{x,e},
e=Exponent[MinimalPolynomial[r,x],x];
Catch[Do[Block[{re,im},{re,im}=RootReduce[ReIm[Root[r[[1]],n]]];
If[!ExactNumberQ[re]&&Exponent[MinimalPolynomial[re,x],x]<e,Throw[re]];
If[!ExactNumberQ[im]&&Exponent[MinimalPolynomial[im,x],x]<e,Throw[im]]],{n,e}]]];

(* INPUT CELL 5 *)
ClearAll[factor];
factor[poly_Root,ext_]:=factor[poly,ext,poly];
factor[poly_,ext_,root_]:=Block[{x,mp},mp=If[poly[[0]]===Root,MinimalPolynomial[poly,x],poly];
With[{product=Factor[mp,Extension -> ext]},
If[product[[0]]=!=Times,
product,
Select[List@@product,PossibleZeroQ[#/.x -> root]&,1][[1]]]]];

(* INPUT CELL 6 *)
ClearAll[solve];
solve[e_]:=With[{eq=If[e[[0]]===Equal,e,e == 0]},
Select[x/.Solve[eq,x],PossibleZeroQ[Im[#]]&,1][[1]]]
solve[e_,r_Root]:=With[{eq=If[e[[0]]===Equal,e,e == 0]},
Select[x/.Solve[eq,x],PossibleZeroQ[#-r]&,1][[1]]];

(* INPUT CELL 7 *)
ClearAll[roots];
roots[r_Root]:=With[{p=Exponent[MinimalPolynomial[r,x],x]},Table[Root[r[[1]],n],{n,p}]];
roots[poly_]:=With[{p=Exponent[poly,x]},Table[Root[poly&/.x -> #,n],{n,p}]];

(* INPUT CELL 8 *)
ClearAll[fuzz];
fuzz[r_]:=fuzz[r,Length[roots[r]]-1];
fuzz[r_,max_Integer]:=With[{rs=roots[r]},
Block[{appx,x,s,n=0,mp,seen=<||>,$MaxExtraPrecision=2000},
PrintTemporary[Dynamic[n]];
While[True,
With[{sam=Sort[RandomSample[rs,RandomInteger[{2,Length[rs]}]]]},(*RandomInteger[{2,Length[rs]}]*)
If[!KeyExistsQ[seen,sam],
seen[sam]=True;
s=(Plus@@sam);
appx=RootApproximant[N[s,400],max];
mp=MinimalPolynomial[appx,x];
If[!IntegerQ[appx]&&!KeyExistsQ[seen,mp],
seen[mp]=True;
n++;
If[Quiet[PossibleZeroQ[s-appx],PossibleZeroQ::ztest1],Print[appx]]]]]]]];

(* INPUT CELL 9 *)
ClearAll[simplify];
simplify[x_]:=Block[{e=x,s,t=10},
Print[{Now,LeafCount[e],Simplify`SimplifyCount[e],ByteCount[e],StringLength[ToString[e,InputForm]]}];
While[True,
With[{timeout=Quiet[Check[s=FullSimplify[e,TimeConstraint -> {t,t},TransformationFunctions -> {Automatic,collect,ComplexExpand},
ComplexityFunction -> (Simplify`SimplifyCount[#]+(10)^(3)Count[#,_ArcTan|_ArcCot,All]+(10)^(10)Count[#,Except[Root[-1+9 #1-684 (#1)^(2)+3972 (#1)^(3)-12033 (#1)^(4)+19647 (#1)^(5)+3318 (#1)^(6)+6111 (#1)^(7)-657 (#1)^(8)+(#1)^(9)&,3],_Root]|_Cosh|_Sinh,All]&)],"\<Timeout\>"]==="\<Timeout\>",FullSimplify::gtime]},
If[!timeout&&s===e,Return[s,Block]];
If[timeout&&s===e,
Print["\<Time: \>",Round[t*=1.5]],
e=s;
Print[Framed[e]];
Print[{Now,LeafCount[e],Simplify`SimplifyCount[e],ByteCount[e],StringLength[ToString[e,InputForm]]}]
]
]
]
]

(* INPUT CELL 10 *)
??collect

(* INPUT CELL 11 *)
beta=InverseBetaRegularized[(1)/(9),(1)/(3),(1)/(3)];

(* INPUT CELL 12 *)
nbeta=With[{p=1000},With[{v=N[beta,(3)/(2)p]},SetPrecision[v,p]]];

(* INPUT CELL 13 *)
root=RootApproximant[nbeta,30]

(* INPUT CELL 14 *)
findExtension3[root]

(* INPUT CELL 15 *)
RootApproximant[N[Sqrt[46603+32313 (3)^(1/3)+22405 (3)^(2/3)+(69174+47962 (3)^(1/3)+33254 (3)^(2/3)) Cos[(Pi)/(9)]+2 (18387+12749 (3)^(1/3)+8840 (3)^(2/3)) Cos[(2 Pi)/(9)]],800],18]

(* INPUT CELL 16 *)
 

(* INPUT CELL 17 *)
factor[root,(3)^(1/6)]

(* INPUT CELL 18 *)
factor[1+(-45-27 (3)^(1/3)-18 (3)^(2/3)) x+(-504-378 (3)^(1/3)-252 (3)^(2/3)) (x)^(2)+(3081+2187 (3)^(1/3)+1458 (3)^(2/3)) (x)^(3)+(-4437-3051 (3)^(1/3)-2034 (3)^(2/3)) (x)^(4)+(1071+621 (3)^(1/3)+414 (3)^(2/3)) (x)^(5)+(1623+1215 (3)^(1/3)+810 (3)^(2/3)) (x)^(6)+(-828-594 (3)^(1/3)-396 (3)^(2/3)) (x)^(7)+(36+27 (3)^(1/3)+18 (3)^(2/3)) (x)^(8)+(x)^(9),{(3)^(1/6),Root[-1+9 #1-684 (#1)^(2)+3972 (#1)^(3)-12033 (#1)^(4)+19647 (#1)^(5)+3318 (#1)^(6)+6111 (#1)^(7)-657 (#1)^(8)+(#1)^(9)&,3]},root]
